info.name: Guest Desk API
info.description:
Test collection for the Guest Desk backend (Ktor, base path /api).

Run order the first time: 1a Login Admin, 2a Create Owner (saves owner_id, owner_schema, owner_email, owner_temp_password), 1b Login Owner, 3a Create Property, 4a Create Device, 4e Activate Device (saves device_token), 5a Create Product, 6a Create Order, 7a Initiate Payment (the order becomes CONFIRMED), then 6e PREPARING, 6f OUT_FOR_DELIVERY and 6g DELIVERED. Run 6a again before 7b and 6j: a paid order cannot be paid twice and a delivered order cannot be cancelled. Folders 9 to 11 cover food platforms, platform settings and lookups.

Roles: PLATFORM_ADMIN (admin_token), OWNER (owner_token), DEVICE (device_token, kiosk). Tenant routes called as PLATFORM_ADMIN take the tenant via the schemaName query parameter. Only /health, /auth/login, /auth/refresh, /devices/resolve and /devices/{id}/activate are unauthenticated; /devices/{id}/ping needs the device token and /auth/change-password needs a JWT. Prices are euro cents. The payment acquirer and the food platforms are emulated; SMTP, the GEMH registry and geocoding are real.

item.name: 1a. Login - Platform Admin
item.description: Demo admin created by _Deployment/python/seed_admin.py.

item.name: 1b. Login - Owner
item.description: Run after 2a (Create Owner), which saves owner_email, owner_temp_password and owner_schema. For the seeded demo owner set owner_email / owner_temp_password to owner@guestdesk.io / Owner@GuestDesk1 and owner_schema to that owner's schema (see GET /owners).

item.name: 1c. Refresh Token - Admin
item.description: Refresh tokens rotate: the previous refresh token stops working.

item.name: 1e. Change Password - Wrong Current (expect 400)
item.description: A signed-in admin or owner changes their own password (POST /auth/change-password). A wrong current password is a 400, not a 401, so the web panel does not treat it as an expired session. On success the response is a new token pair and every other session of the user is signed out.

item.name: 2f. Deactivate Owner
item.description: Soft removal. Owners have no hard delete. The owner can no longer log in or refresh.

item.name: 3e. Deactivate Property
item.description: Cascades: all devices of the property are deactivated.

item.name: 3g. Delete Property
item.description: Hard delete. Run last, or create another property first.

item.name: 3h. List Properties (Admin, cross-tenant)
item.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN selects the tenant with the schemaName query parameter. The same applies to every tenant route below.

item.name: 4a. Create Device
item.description: Response contains activationCode and qrCodeBase64 (QR for the kiosk app). androidDeviceId is optional.

item.name: 4d. Resolve Device by Activation Code (no auth)
item.description: Manual-entry flow: returns deviceId and schemaName for an activation code.

item.name: 4e. Activate Device (no auth, kiosk flow)
item.description: Returns a long-lived DEVICE JWT in the token field. The code can be used once.

item.name: 4f. Ping Device (device token, heartbeat)
item.description: Heartbeat sent by the kiosk once a minute with its own device JWT; updates lastSeenAt. Run after 4e Activate Device.

item.name: 4g. Deactivate Device
item.description: Invalidates the device token immediately (device activity is checked on every request).

item.name: 4i. Unregister Device
item.description: Resets the device to unactivated with a fresh activation code/QR; keeps the record.

item.name: 5a. Create Product
item.description: basePrice is in euro cents. Categories: BEVERAGE, HOT_DRINK, FOOD, SNACK, ALCOHOL, PERSONAL_CARE, PHARMACY, OTHER.

item.name: 5c. List Products (kiosk catalog, device JWT)
item.description: For DEVICE tokens the list is filtered to products available at the device's property.

item.name: 5h. Disable Product at Property
item.description: Per-property override on top of the tenant-wide flag.

item.name: 5j. Import Products from Platform
item.description: Run 9b and 9c first (9c saves catalog_product_id). Copies catalog items from a connected platform into the tenant's own products.

item.name: 6a. Create Order (device JWT)
item.description: Kiosk flow. type is IN_ROOM_STORE or FOOD_DELIVERY; FOOD_DELIVERY also needs platform and restaurantId, and items reference platform menu item ids.

item.name: 6c. List Orders by Status
item.description: Statuses: PENDING, CONFIRMED, PREPARING, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED.

item.name: 6j. Cancel Own Order (device JWT; run 6a first for a fresh order)
7a. Initiate Payment - contactless
item.description: Emulated acquirer. entryMode: CARD_CONTACTLESS (approved), CARD_CHIP (pinVerified false is declined), CARD_MAGSTRIPE (declined). On success a receipt email is sent when SMTP is configured.

item.name: 7b. Initiate Payment - chip + PIN (run 6a first for a fresh order)
item.description: The PIN itself never leaves the terminal; only the verification result is sent.

item.name: 7c. List Payments of an Order (Owner)
item.description: OWNER role only.

item.name: 9b. Connect Platform
item.description: Platforms: efood, wolt, box (emulated). Any API key of at least 8 characters is accepted.

item.name: 9c. Platform Catalog
item.description: Requires a connected platform.

item.name: 9e. Set Property Platforms
item.description: Which connected platforms this property offers on the kiosk.

item.name: 10b. Update SMTP Settings
item.description: security: STARTTLS, SSL or NONE. Omit password (null) to keep the stored one. The password is stored encrypted and never returned.

item.name: 10e. Update GEMH API Key
item.description: API key from opendata.businessportal.gr.

item.name: 11a. Company Lookup by VAT (Admin)
item.description: Queries the GEMH registry; needs the API key from 10e.

item.name: 11b. Geocode Search
item.description: Nominatim; the query needs at least 3 characters. Owner or admin.
